name: ScorchedSoil
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.570

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: Poly Haven mud_cracked_dry_riverbed_002 (2x2, self-blended with a quarter-turned copy) height-blended with burned_ground_01 (charred turf, dead straw; non-commensurate scale), desaturated to char with pale ash settled in the hollows
known_weaknesses: 1.95 mm per pixel: cracks soften under 1 m; the burnt-straw layer is 1.37 times life size; the original wasteland tiles are grey-green rock, this is the darker scorched reading the brief asks for
